_comment: Source of truth for the per-section Open Graph cards. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/og/generate.py (see tools/og/README.md). 'routes' lists every top-level path that shows this card; 'seo' is the ROUTE_SEO key in script.js whose title and description the crawler shell carries; 'canonical' overrides the canonical URL for alias routes.
